exposure: single instillation of intravaginal Prostaglandin E2 gel
multiple instillations of intravaginal Prostaglandin E2 gel
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent induction of labor with intravaginal Prostaglandin E2 gel.
finding: Multiple instillations of intravaginal Prostaglandin E2 gel for induction of labour did not increase the risk of complications for mothers or babies and was more effective in achieving vaginal delivery, especially in nulliparous women.
mod_finding: Three doses of intravaginal PGE2 can be safely used without the risk of uterine hyperstimulation and there is no increased fetal risk with multiple instillations.
